# Move-over

Move-over is a capture-the-flag wargame for Move smart contracts on Sui.
Primary audience: developers learning Move and smart contract security.

## Canonical URLs
- https://move-over.vercel.app/en
- https://move-over.vercel.app/en/levels/how-to-play
- https://move-over.vercel.app/en/levels/0

## Content
- Level pages contain challenge instructions and contract code.
- Users write a `run()` function that returns a `*Flag` proof type.
- Verification runs client-side in browser via WebAssembly worker.

## Ownership
- Brand: OpenZeppelin
- Website: https://www.openzeppelin.com/
